Hey Samir / Priya — Jordan from Solutions here, thanks for the SOW and the heads-up. Short technical notes so the demo is productive: 

1) KV/prefix caching: the hosted sandbox supports ephemeral KV cache for the session; for persistent prefix caching across restarts we recommend the dedicated evaluation instance — I can show the runtime behavior and simulated persistent cache using a short prefix replay during the demo.

2) Latency profiling: to make the 30-min slot useful, please bring 2 payloads (one short, one long). We'll run a pair of sample requests and show the per-token latency breakdown in the Console.

3) Token tracing & privacy: if you'd like token-level tracing enabled we will only store traces temporarily and redact PII; please confirm consent if you want that on.

I've attached a short demo-runbook that I use for PLG quickwalks (outline + commands). This is just a reference: demo-steps.md

If 10:00 PT on Wed 7/15 works, I can be on that slot. Otherwise 15:30 PT also fine for me.

—Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
